test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 4 men and 5 women can earn Rs. 8,800 in 8 days. 7 men and 10 women can earn Rs. 10,250 in 5 days. In how many days will 8 men and 12 women earn Rs. 21,600?
solution:
**Given**

4 men and 5 women can earn Rs. 8,800 in 8 days 

7 men and 10 women can earn Rs. 10,250 in 5 days.

**Calculation**

 4 men and 5 women 1 day earning = 8800/8

4 men and 5 women 1 day earning = 1100

7 men and 10 women 1 day earning = 10250/5

7 men and 10 women 1 day earning = 2050

let the men earning is x and women earning is y

4x + 5y = 1100

4x = 1100 - 5y

x = (1100 - 5y)/4 ---- (1)

7x + 10y = 2050

7(1100 - 5y)/4 + 10y = 2050 (from 1)

⇒ (7700 - 35y)/4 + 10y = 2050

⇒ (7700 - 35y + 40y)/4 = 2050

⇒ 7700 + 5y = 2050 × 4

⇒ 7700 + 5y = 8200

⇒ 5y = 8200 - 7700

⇒ 5y = 500

⇒ y = 100

x = (1100 - 5 × 100)/4

⇒ x = 600/4

⇒ x = 150

one day earning of 8 men and 12 women is (8 × 150) + (12 × 100)

⇒ 1200 + 1200

⇒ 2400

21600 earns by 8 men and 12 women in 9 days.

**∴ 8 men and 12 women earns Rs. 21,600 in 9 days i.e. (21600/2400)**
